video_title: Boogie - BLOW UP The Pelicans! Get Zion Out Of There!

quotes.speaker: DeMarcus Cousins
quotes.summary_phrase: DeMarcus Cousins argues it is time for Zion Williamson to move on
quotes.excerpt: It's time to move on. If I'm Zion, it's time to move on.

text_blocks.speaker: Michelle Beadle
text_blocks.text: Boogie, we know Dejounte's situation and his desires. Should they just trade Zion? By the way, we do this every season. Every single season we're like, 'Should they trade Zion?' Should we finally do something, please, for the love of everything?

text_blocks.speaker: DeMarcus Cousins
text_blocks.text: Blow that shit up. We have not got the results we've been looking for yet. I don't even know what year this is for Zion. It's time to move on. If I'm Zion, it's time to move on. It has nothing to do with the Pelicans, it has nothing to do with the rest of the roster, this is about Zion. If you care about your legacy, your career, move on.

quotes.speaker: Chandler Parsons
quotes.summary_phrase: Chandler Parsons believes the Pelicans have enough talent to trade for assets
quotes.excerpt: I want seven dudes on this team that you could trade and you can, whether it's lateral or you can get better.
quotes.quote: They have a first-year coach, Willie Green, who I feel like this is just a bad opportunity for him. He got a raw end in Orlando. Now he's really in a dark place with them starting off 4 and 10. And this team has talent. I was talking about the Jazz earlier. I want seven dudes on this team that you could trade and you can, whether it's lateral or you can get better. There is so much talent from Murphy to Saddiq Bey to Zion, Dyson Daniels, Jordan Hawkins. There are so many guys on this roster that can produce for other NBA teams. It's the only bright side for this team though, because they're not competitive. They just seem like they don't even want to be there.

quotes.speaker: Michelle Beadle
quotes.summary_phrase: Michelle Beadle questions if Luka Doncic is undervalued for MVP despite his performance
quotes.excerpt: Do we sort of look at Luka like, 'Well, I don't take him seriously that he's going to win a championship'?

text_blocks.speaker: Michelle Beadle
text_blocks.text: Wemby is averaging 30 points a game and he's playing just under 30 minutes a game. He's finished now second in MVP voting last year, and we've talked a lot of Luka MVP. I want to know, and this is maybe just my own theory, subconsciously, do we sort of look at Luka like, 'Well, I don't take him seriously that he's going to win a championship, but I do think he will win the MVP,' and maybe that's why we give him so much MVP love versus Wemby?

quotes.speaker: DeMarcus Cousins
quotes.summary_phrase: DeMarcus Cousins praises Luka Doncic's defensive engagement this season
quotes.excerpt: Luka is absolutely dominating on the offensive side of the ball. He's engaged on the defensive end.
quotes.quote: Both guys are doing their thing this year in different ways. Luka is absolutely dominating on the offensive side of the ball. Like I said earlier, this is something that we've only seen a handful of times in this league, so you have to give him his flowers for the offensive performance he's doing every night. And on top of that, he's engaged on the defensive end, that's always kind of been his knock. He's leading this group, so he's doing everything he's supposed to. Wemby, I believe has a more talented team, but he's also the foundation of this group. They're dominating in two different ways, but has such an impact on their individual groups.

quotes.speaker: Lou Williams
quotes.summary_phrase: Lou Williams insists Luka Doncic is the clear MVP leader right now
quotes.excerpt: Anybody that's averaging 40 and 8 is the leader for the MVP right now.
quotes.quote: I know we're making good TV, but it ain't even science to me. Anybody that's averaging 40 and 8 is the leader for the MVP right now. Everything else, you can cut the radio off. Guys that average 30 plus, that's a Steve Nash, and guess what? You know why you remember that? Because it's a controversy to this day he didn't get it. Kobe should have won that. That's why we still remember that, because it was a controversy him not getting it. But anybody averaging 40 and 8, and if he can stick around 35 plus throughout the season, it's not even a conversation. I don't care who they got as teammates.
